raw_comment:
1. The first thing I noticed when I saw this graph was how widespread the issue of drought is throughout our nation. The issue is not limited to one or a few regions. While it is a more prevalent concern to some than others, given the range of severity, it is a nationwide issue actively impacting nearly all of us. I also noticed that the most severe and exceptional cases are within landlocked states, which makes a lot of sense, given the coasts are usually less susceptible to drought. The fact that even coasts are in drought is concerning.
2. I wonder if there is anything that we, as individuals, can do to help minimize this nationwide threat. I have to assume that a lot of this has to do with climate change, so I wonder how much of this issue is due in part to human activity.
3. This feels personal to me because I have family in the Midwest and am also applying to a number of colleges there. While I love this area, it seems to be the region where the most severe cases of drought occur. With drought comes a number of threats, such as wildfires, that endanger my family and make the area a higher risk to live in.  
4. America is Drying Out: A Coast-to-Coast Glance at Drought in the United States
